{{Top|leg}}
'''''Casper Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The squadron attempted to defend the [[XQ3 Platform]] ''[[Cyrlus]]''. They were ultimately unsuccessful and were wiped out, along with the platform.

*[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']] {{1st}} {{C|Simulator appearance only}}
